capabilities: chat with AI models in a sidebar
manage multiple chat threads with persistent history
adjust temperature and max tokens per response
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Free tiers exist for all cloud providers; no credit card required.

summary: AI chat assistant that adds a sidebar for chatting with Gemini, Groq, Cerebras, OpenRouter, or local Ollama models.
